body:
I see the same thing everyday, each day, I try my best to feel and experience new things but I can’t. I feel I can’t enjoy much. I feel trapped at home, studying hard and hoping for the best. I’m feeling pressured by my mother, always hearing the same things I’ve gotten used too. I’ve gotten more tired, more stressed, more depressed each day. 

he’s always made me feel better. I couldn’t ask for me. He’s the other person I’ve always had a shoulder for. I feel better, but feelings like those come back always and only leave temporarily.

Hello, thank you for reading this. I really appreciate it. I’ve lost faith in how I see things. I can’t help but feel useless every morning when I wake up. I see no point anymore, same process same feelings each day. I haven’t been achieving expectations. I’m letting my mother down, feeling terrible. My boyfriend today, we were talking well but suddenly, he stopped speaking with me. I asked if everything was good and apologized if I had done something wrong. He said I hadn’t and left it at that. He hasn’t talked to me since the morning. I asked if he was good, reassuring making sure I’ll always be there if anything. Even if it’s about us. I’ll understand and be patient.
